from PIL import Image

def count_white_pillows(image_path):
    image = Image.open(image_path)
    pillow_counts = {}
    for pillow in image.convert("RGB"):
        color = tuple(pillow)
        if "white" in str(color):
            if "white" in pillow_counts:
                pillow_counts["white"] += 1
            else:
                pillow_counts["white"] = 1
    return pillow_counts[["white"]]
